Jobs.description: Developed Mantis, an all-in-one privacy tool for investors to shield and anonymize transactions on the Solana network. Built on-chain smart contracts in Rust using the Anchor framework to preserve transaction anonymity and prevent double spending. Engineered an off-chain TypeScript crank daemon to drive scheduled payouts, sealed destinations, and inject decoy cover-traffic to strengthen anonymity guarantees.

Developed a cryptocurrency privacy suite designed to obfuscate and secure transactions on the Solana network. Developed on-chain smart contracts using Rust's Arcium framework, with a focus on secure and efficient transaction logic. Created instructions to fully hide transaction data while maintaining full on-chain verifiability. Designed a fully on-chain architecture, eliminating the need for off-chain databases by leveraging Solana's data storage capabilities. Built a TypeScript SDK for monitoring and interacting with on-chain data, enabling developer-friendly access to protocol state. Implemented an automated bot to ensure data consistency and integrity across on-chain processes.

Managed the dev team that developed the Albany Rural Cemetery Explorer (ARCE). Deployed mobile applications using the Expo framework to make the source code cross-functional across different mobile platforms. Used TypeScript, ReactJS, as well as the GeoJSON and Leaflet APIs to map and display coordinate data for the burials within the cemetery. Worked in an Agile CI/CD framework to address user needs and deliver constant updates.
Teaching Assistant for professor Crnkic in CINF 202 (Intro to databases). Assisted in teaching database concepts, as well as familiarizing students with SQL, NoSQL, and other database tools.

Created a new feature within the Higher Services Corporation (HESC) portal web application which enables internal users to view and edit critical student data within the International Scholarship and Tuition Services (ISTS) database table. Used Java, Spring Boot, and SQL for the backend within the Spring framework, using the Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) API to query the ISTS table to deliver data to users.

Assisted in tabletop exercises of recovery plan and helped prepare written reports for the DR (Disaster Recovery) team, which has the objective of documenting emergency plans for organizations to follow. Participated in tabletop exercises in which we would simulate disasters for the critical applications to then implement their recovery plan. Analyzed system specifications in order to document and formalize a recovery plan.

Developed a gpt-based onboarding bot which gives new users useful information regarding the common tools which are used by various teams, and provides answers of commonly asked questions. Created with python’s Openai API and langchain API to develop the bot which pulls the useful information off a vectorstore database, and uses the Flask API to host the bots’ services. Utilized ReactJS, Javascript, Figma, and storybook for developing the UI for the bot. Collaborated with team members to manage version control using Github and docker.
Developing application using virtual reality, computer vision, and machine learning to help firefighters detect and protect themselves from fire hazards
Assisted students in Information in the 21st Century (CINF 101x) at the University at Albany
